en: I have learned much of potions over the long years, $n, and that knowledge is at your disposal. You have only to ask.

The Master holds great interest in the lair of Nefarian. If only someone would defeat the dragon and his minions and retell the tale to the Prince. I bet that would loosen the Prince's lips. The Ashbringer could be found!
I have a pretty good idea what ol' Greatfather Winter's gonna be doing when this shift is over.  I got a bottle of Winter Veil cheer right here in my bag, and I intend to get to the bottom of it.
Undead are crawling all over the land.  Where is the Stormwind Army?
Please unlock the courtyard door.

For 10,000 years I have ruled this kingdom. In that time, I have heard many fascinating tales from those that would walk the hallowed grounds of the House of Shen'dralar.$B$BAs I am bound to this place, I often exchange stories with visitors. Do you have a story for me or perhaps you would like to hear a story?
Enemies have reached the door!  Move in!  We must hold!
This had better be good....
Show me what you've got, rookie!
Your undeath is not the end of your life, but the beginning. It is up to you to decide where your fate lies now.
%s takes aim again...
CLUCK!  Sensors detect spatial anomaly -- danger imminent!  CLUCK!
My Zandalar Demoniac's Wraps have gone missing. Can you provide me with another set?
With your help, I can evaluate these tunnels.
Elune be with us! Let's make haste from this evil fortress.
Merideth, could I have some more manna-enriched horse feed please?
We have one eye and see better than you!  Bank in center of Undercity!

Good question, $r. In my younger days I was footloose and fancy free without a care in the world. In those days I would sing in a barber shop quartet out of Stormwind known as the Four Dons. That's where I learned how to craft the Bonescythe digs.
The temperature is... not hot enough!

Meat, skin, bones... a good hunter lets nothing go to waste. Every scrap of leather can be salvaged, perhaps to reinforce an ally's armor. Thus, each of us is strong alone, but together we become invincible.
This blue light... It's strange, $N. What do you think it means?
Hail, $N!  Welcome to my humble garden.  The weather has been perfect lately.  Let us hope it holds steady for a ripe harvest.
We orcs are usually a private people, but lately, no one's been hiding their feelings.
May your skills in smelting dark iron serve you well, $n.  But do not let your knowledge corrupt you... as it corrupted us.
I require training, Lumak.
Who dares intrude upon the Blackrock Clan?  Death to this $R!
Rolls, buns and bread. Baked fresh!
I sure could use a kiss about now.  Know where I can find one?
You're very welcome! I must be on my way... be safe, all of you.

In exchange for one Sulfuron Ingot, I am authorized to grant you one copy of the plans to forge a Sulfuron hammer.$B$BNow an adventurer like yourself is probably thinking to $g himself:herself;, "What would I ever need a hammer like that for when what I already own is far superior?"$B$BWell let me tell you something, $g mister:missy;, there ain't nothing more superior than what the Sulfuron hammer can become!
%s shrugs.
The School for Necromancy known as Scholomance is on the ruined island of Caer Darrow in the Western Plaguelands.
Ye should check over at Steelgrill's Depot for Bronk.  When he's not tinkering with some odd device, he's usually chatting up the pilots about their steam tanks.
You're sweet for asking, $c, but we have all of the light leather that we need. May be that one of the others in charge of collecting around here is in need of your assistance though?
I would like to train.
A defender has fallen!
Look out! We're under attack!
You should talk to Winstone. I hear he's looking for thieves with your skill.
